question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**spots**" means specific locations or points. (जगहें)
 
• In the context of the sentence, "spots" refers to different interesting locations or points within the lake regions.
 
• The other options: "**sections**," "**marks**," and "**periods**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Indulge in a leisurely boat ride to visit the many spots__ that the vast expanse of the lake encompasses - the beacon island, bird island to name a few and of course watch the migratory birds and the critically endangered Irrawaddy Dolphins frolic in the prey laden brackish waters.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sections (खंड)**: means distinct parts into which something is divided or may be divided.
 
• **Marks (चिन्ह)**: means small areas on a surface having a different color from its surroundings.
 
• **Periods (अवधियां)**: means lengths or portions of time.
